title: Local multiplicity-one representations by an embedded C¹ submanifold glue to one continuous orientation (parent steps 4–5, F3)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, C ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ m), M ⊆ ℝ^P a Borel embedded C¹ m-dimensional submanifold, ρ : ℝ^P → ℝ, and ξ_y : ℝ^P → Λ_m(ℝ^P) (ξs y) for each y ∈ ℝ^P. Write B_y := B_{ρ(y)}(y). Assume for every y ∈ M: ρ(y) > 0; ξ_y is an orientation of M ∩ B_y (IsOrientation m (M ∩ B_y) ξ_y); H^m(M ∩ B_y) < ∞; and C(ω) = ∫_{M ∩ B_y} ⟨ω(x), ξ_y(x)⟩ dH^m(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) with tsupport ω ⊆ B_y (H^m = μHE[m]). Then there is ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_m(ℝ^P) such that: ξ is an orientation of M (IsOrientation m M ξ); ξ = ξ_y on M ∩ B_y for every y ∈ M; and C(ω) = ∫_M ⟨ω(x), ξ(x)⟩ dH^m(x) for every y ∈ M and every ω ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) with tsupport ω ⊆ B_y.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (ρ : Euclid P → ℝ) (ξs : Euclid P → Euclid P → MultiVector P m), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → MeasurableSet M → (∀ y ∈ M, 0 < ρ y ∧ IsOrientation m (M ∩ ball y (ρ y)) (ξs y) ∧ μHE[m] (M ∩ ball y (ρ y)) ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ ball y (ρ y) → C ω = ∫ x in M ∩ ball y (ρ y), ξs y x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂μHE[m]) → ∃ ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P m, IsOrientation m M ξ ∧ (∀ y ∈ M, ∀ x ∈ M ∩ ball y (ρ y), ξ x = ξs y x) ∧ ∀ y ∈ M, ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ ball y (ρ y) → C ω = ∫ x in M, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂μHE[m]
